packageRules.description: Automerge every update of every dependency — patch, minor, major, digest, pin, rollback — e2e CI is the only gate; the preset's minimumReleaseAge soak still applies
Automerged federated config updates use versionless PR titles, so a following update must not be blocked by the merged one

prBodyNotes: **SLE constraint**: Go is installed via `zypper install go${GO_VERSION}`, so only versions packaged in the SLE repos are valid. An automerged bump that fails e2e usually means SLE has not shipped the version yet.

packageRules.description: Delve updates carry a Go-compat note; automerge is governed by the repository-wide rule above
prBodyNotes: **Go compatibility**: Delve's supported Go range must include the SLE-packaged Go version; e2e CI validates the pair when automerging.
